verdict.rationale: YYLO documents autonomous agent automation through reusable YAML workflows, a Workflow Runner, `yy loop`, a run-until-completion script that repeats iterations until no open kanban work remains, and bounded parallel fan-out. The GitHub README shows runs emitting watch receipts with a COMPLETED state, and the integrations script pulls Slack messages or GitHub issues into kanban and posts completed responses back. However, there is no evidence of scheduled or triggered execution, or of a daemon that keeps running unattended, so true background automation is only implied. Missing for 10: scheduling/cron or event triggers, an explicit detached background or daemon mode, and independent hands-on corroboration of unattended runs.
